title: Run your first file
summary: Create a tiny program and run it from the terminal.

steps.instruction: In your editor, create a file named hello.js in an empty folder.
Type this one line, then save.
steps.expectedResult: The file contains only that line.

steps.instruction: In the terminal, cd to that folder and run the file with Node.
steps.expectedResult: Hello from Learn SD prints. If Node is missing, finish the Node.js setup guide first.

steps.instruction: Optional: create hello.py with print("Hello from Learn SD") and run it.
steps.expectedResult: The same greeting prints from Python. Two languages, same idea: a file in, text out.
